maddeler.e:
نحتقر (form VIII)
# نَحْتَقِرُ (naḥtaqiru) /naħ.ta.qi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# نُحْتَقَرُ (nuḥtaqaru) /nuħ.ta.qa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# نَحْتَقِرَ (naḥtaqira) /naħ.ta.qi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# نُحْتَقَرَ (nuḥtaqara) /nuħ.ta.qa.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
